parsed_json.sql: SELECT m.chembl_id AS chembl_id, m.pref_name AS pref_name, di.mesh_id AS mesh_id, di.mesh_heading AS mesh_heading, di.mesh_id AS indication_curie, di.mesh_heading AS indication_label, di.max_phase_for_ind AS max_phase_for_ind FROM molecule_dictionary m JOIN drug_indication di ON m.molregno = di.molregno ORDER BY m.chembl_id, m.pref_name, di.mesh_id, di.mesh_heading, di.mesh_id, di.mesh_heading, di.max_phase_for_ind
